title: [P] NKI layer megakernels for GLM-5.3-Flash on AWS Trainium2: where a decode step's time went, and what we changed [P]
summary: We wrote an inference engine for AWS Trainium2 that serves GLM-5.3-Flash (320B MoE, 1M-token context) on one trn2.48xlarge, and open-sourced it. Most of the work went into decode, and the part I found most interesting is how little of a decode step was the model's actual math. In
